activation_with_caller_guard.answer: JOB-STEP由LAUNCHER在READY-FLAG = 1的源码条件下通过CALL调用。源码未证明外部调度绑定，也未证明实际执行。[ev_page_98d52f403a399b917e97f477]

cl_batch_context.answer: 源码先提交 NIGHTJOB，再由 CL 调用 BATCHPAY，INLLIBL 声明 RUNLIB DATALIB。[ev_page_76fe8bb32099bd0b4fb5058d] OVRDBF 声明 ACCOUNTLF 指向 DATALIB/ACCOUNTPF，成员为 &DAY，作用域 *CALLLVL。[ev_page_85a13dabf3fd11acfac5a12f] DLTOVR 之后还有另一次 BATCHPAY 调用，两次调用位置分别保留。[ev_page_85a13dabf3fd11acfac5a12f] 实际调度、运行库列表、成员值和覆盖是否生效仍未知。

A          R ACCOUNTREC                 PFILE(ACCOUNTPF)
     A            ACCOUNTAMT     9S 2

>>SOURCE FORMAT FREE
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. BATCHPAY.
ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
FILE-CONTROL.
    SELECT ACCOUNT-FILE ASSIGN TO 'ACCOUNTLF'.
DATA DIVISION.
FILE SECTION.
FD ACCOUNT-FILE.
01 ACCOUNT-RECORD.
   05 ACCOUNT-AMOUNT PIC 9(7)V99.
WORKING-STORAGE SECTION.
01 FILE-STATUS PIC XX.
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN.
    OPEN I-O ACCOUNT-FILE
    READ ACCOUNT-FILE
        AT END MOVE '10' TO FILE-STATUS
    END-READ
    CLOSE ACCOUNT-FILE
    GOBACK.

PGM PARM(&DAY)
DCL VAR(&DAY) TYPE(*CHAR) LEN(8)
CHGLIBL LIBL(RUNLIB DATALIB) CURLIB(RUNLIB)
ADDLIBLE LIB(STAGELIB) POSITION(*FIRST)
OVRDBF FILE(ACCOUNTLF) TOFILE(DATALIB/ACCOUNTPF) +
       MBR(&DAY) OVRSCOPE(*CALLLVL)
CALL PGM(BATCHPAY) PARM(&DAY 'CALL PGM(FAKEJOB)')
MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000) EXEC(CALL PGM(RUNLIB/LOGFAIL))
DLTOVR FILE(ACCOUNTLF) LVL(*)
CALL PGM(BATCHPAY) PARM(&DAY)
/* CALL PGM(COMMENTJOB) */
SNDMSG MSG('SBMJOB CMD(CALL PGM(STRINGJOB)) /* literal */') TOUSR(*SYSOPR)
ENDPGM

PGM
/* Source submission is visible; the production scheduler is not. */
SBMJOB CMD(CALL PGM(RUNLIB/NIGHTJOB) PARM('20261015')) +
       JOB(NIGHTPAY) JOBD(CFGLIB/BATCHDESC) INLLIBL(RUNLIB DATALIB)
MONMSG MSGID(CPF0000) EXEC(CALL PGM(RUNLIB/LOGFAIL))
ENDPGM
